chunks: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn ash-Shah, Abul Hussein, the jurisprudent in Marv al-Ruz, narrated that Ibrahim ibn Abdul Razzaq, Abu Ishaq al-Antaki, narrated that Yahya ibn al-Mustafad narrated that Yazid ibn Salma al-Numayri narrated that Isa ibn Yunis, on the authority of Zakariya ibn Abi Za'idah (on the authority of Za'idah), on the authority of Zadan, on the authority of Zar ibn Hubaysh, that he heard Muhammad ibn al-Hanafiyah (may Allah be pleased with him) say:

In us are six characteristics that were not in anyone who came before us, and shall not be in anyone who comes after us: From us are Muhammad, the Master of the Messengers; and Ali, the Master of the Trustees; and Hamzah, the Master of the Martyrs; and Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn, the Masters of the Youth of the People of Paradise; and Ja'far ibn Abi Talib, adorned with two wings, by which he flies in Paradise wherever he wishes; and the Mahdi of this nation, behind whom Isa ibn Maryam (peace be upon him) will pray.

key_terms.شَبَابُ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ: Youth of the People of Paradise

ai.seo_question: What are the six unique characteristics of the Ahl al-Bayt mentioned in this hadith from al-Khisal?
ai.summary: Recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Al-Khisal*, this hadith from Ibn al-Hanafiyya highlights six unique spiritual stations of the Ahl al-Bayt, emphasizing their exclusive status among all generations. It notably identifies Ja'far ibn Abi Talib as 'al-Muzayyan' (the adorned with wings) and concludes with the eschatological sign of the Mahdi being followed by Jesus (Isa), a key tenet in Shia messianic theology.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 6-1 Muhammad ibn Ali ibn ash-Shah Abul Hussein, the jurisprudent in Marv al-Ruz - narrated that Ibrahim ibn Abdul Razzaq Abu Ishaq al-Antaki quoted Yahya ibn al-Mustafad, on the authority of Yazid ibn Salma al-Numayri, on the authority of Isa ibn Yunis, on the authority of Zakariya ibn Abi Za’idah, (on the authority of Za’idah), on the authority of Zadan, on the authority of Zar ibn Hubaysh that he had heard Muhammad ibn al-Hanafy (ra) say,

“There are six characteristics in us which did not exist in anyone (who came) before us, and shall not be in anyone who comes after us: (From us are) Muhammad the Master of the Messengers, and Ali the Master of the Trustees, and Hamzah the Master of the Martyrs , and Al-Hassan and Al-Hussein the Masters of the Youth in Paradise, and Ja’far ibn Abi Talib who will be adorned with two wings from which he will fly in Paradise whenever he wants, and Al-Mahdi of this nation behind whom Jesus the son of Mary (AS) will pray behind.”
